Trumpeter Joe Magnarelli is a native of Syracuse, NY and established himself in New York City in 1986. He has performed in the big bands of Lionel Hampton and Maria Schneider and in combos with Brother Jack McDuff and Ray Barretta. Joe has recorded as a leader on Criss Cross Records while finding time to teach at New Jersey City University.
Joe was interviewed on April 25, 2010 in Utica, NY, by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Utica, in a coffee shop after a great concert with Joe Magnarelli. Welcome.
